title: Carbon enriched mixed metal oxides as novel nanocomposites for efficient brilliant green decontamination.
abstract: Brilliant green dye is a cationic pollutant that poses serious ecological and public-health implications due to its mutagenic as well as cytotoxic effects and its resistance to biodegradation, leading to contamination of aquatic ecosystems and potential organ toxicity in humans.
